definition: To follow a rule or law.
exampleSentence: All employees must comply with the new security policy.

definition: To put money or time into something.
exampleSentence: The company plans to invest in new training programs.

definition: To focus on one area of work.
exampleSentence: Many consultants choose to specialize in cloud security.

definition: To take part in something.
exampleSentence: All team members are expected to participate in the workshop.

definition: To help something happen or succeed.
exampleSentence: Everyone can contribute to the success of the project.

definition: To look at something for information, or to mention it.
exampleSentence: Please refer to the user manual for more details.

definition: To pay regularly for a service.
exampleSentence: Our team decided to subscribe to a new design tool.

definition: To say that you disagree with something.
exampleSentence: Several employees object to the new working hours.

definition: To have the right to get something.
exampleSentence: You qualify for a bonus after one year with the company.

definition: To form a part of a total, or to explain something.
exampleSentence: Online sales account for half of our revenue.

definition: To try to be more successful than others.
exampleSentence: Small companies find it hard to compete with large corporations.

definition: To work together with someone.
exampleSentence: Our team will cooperate with the police during the investigation.

definition: To discuss terms with someone to reach an agreement.
exampleSentence: We need to negotiate with the supplier about delivery times.

definition: To ask someone for advice or discuss something with them.
exampleSentence: Please consult with the legal team before signing the contract.

definition: To get an advantage from something.
exampleSentence: Small businesses can benefit from using cloud services.

definition: To get back to normal after a problem.
exampleSentence: It took the company a year to recover from the cyber attack.

definition: To cause a particular result.
exampleSentence: A small mistake in the code can result in big losses.

definition: To cause something to happen.
exampleSentence: Poor communication in a team can lead to serious misunderstandings.

definition: To promise to do something.
exampleSentence: We can commit to delivering the project by the end of June.

definition: To change to suit a new situation.
exampleSentence: New employees need time to adapt to the company culture.

definition: To respond to something that happens.
exampleSentence: How did the client react to the new price?

definition: To answer a message.
exampleSentence: Please reply to the customer's email before the end of the day.

definition: To think something is good or acceptable.
exampleSentence: My manager does not approve of working late every night.

definition: To say sorry for something.
exampleSentence: I would like to apologize for the delay in my reply.

definition: To be badly affected by a problem.
exampleSentence: Many old banking systems suffer from serious security problems.

definition: To give your opinion about something.
exampleSentence: The manager refused to comment on the rumors about layoffs.

definition: To give all your attention to something.
exampleSentence: I closed my email so I could concentrate on the report.

definition: To explain something in more detail.
exampleSentence: Could you elaborate on your idea for the new campaign?

definition: To choose something after thinking.
exampleSentence: We need to decide on a date for the launch.

definition: Using something as the starting point.
exampleSentence: Our prices are based on the size of your team.

definition: Allowed to have or do something.
exampleSentence: All full-time employees are eligible for private health insurance.

definition: Responsible and expected to explain your actions.
exampleSentence: Team leaders are accountable for the results of their teams.

definition: Dedicated to something.
exampleSentence: Our whole company is committed to protecting customer data.

definition: Working hard for a purpose, or used only for one thing.
exampleSentence: This server is dedicated to running our test environment.

definition: Having knowledge from doing something before.
exampleSentence: We need a developer experienced in mobile apps.

definition: Taking part in something.
exampleSentence: How many people are involved in this project?

definition: Good at something because of training or practice.
exampleSentence: She is highly skilled in data analysis and reporting.

definition: Free to do something.
exampleSentence: Are you available for a quick call this afternoon?

definition: Worried about something.
exampleSentence: Many employees are concerned about the new office plans.

definition: Following or matching something.
exampleSentence: Our prices are in line with the rest of the market.
